svg.title: Prefix, coarse and fine interleaving
svg.desc: Three ways to order audio and text tokens in one sequence. Prefix: one clip up front, then the question, for single-turn question answering and captioning; Qwen2-Audio, SALMONN and LLark work this way. Coarse interleaving: whole clips placed between turns of text, for multi-turn chat, comparing clips and few-shot examples, as in Audio Flamingo 3's multi-turn, multi-audio chat. Fine interleaving: short text and audio chunks alternate on a shared timeline, for streaming speech and time-aligned audio and video; CosyVoice 2 alternates 5 text and 15 speech tokens, GLM-4-Voice 13 and 26, and Qwen2.5-Omni interleaves video and audio in 2-second chunks.
svg.text: whole clips between turns of text
short chunks on a shared timeline
